cohort: 109 pregnant women with a clinical or sonological diagnosis of SGA fetus, excluding pre-eclampsia
finding: Elevated fetal umbilical artery S/D ratio was associated with oligohydramnios and cesarean section, and was a sensitive predictor of abnormal CTG, whilst elevated RI was also associated with abnormal CTG and oligohydramnios.
mod_finding: Fetuses with elevated umbilical artery S/D ratio were more likely to be born by cesarean section (p<0.05)
